remarks:
Welcome to this spacious two-story home set on 2.8 beautiful acres in the town of Lockport! Featuring a wonderful combination of comfortable living spaces, updates, and exceptional garage space, this property offers plenty of room both inside and out.

The family room is a true highlight, featuring a vaulted ceiling, skylight, and wood-burning fireplace, creating a bright and inviting space to relax or entertain. Just off the family room is a delightful three-season room filled with natural light from four skylights, with access to the deck and expansive yard.

The kitchen features new flooring, a new dishwasher, and a brand-new gas range with convection capability. Recent updates include a brand-new boiler, a newer hot water tank, and a roof approximately 1½ years old (2024). New carpet has been added to the stairs and upstairs hallway.

The home offers two full bathrooms on the second floor plus a convenient half bath on the first floor.

Car enthusiasts, hobbyists, or anyone needing abundant storage will appreciate the impressive garage space, including an attached 2½-car garage and a detached four-car garage. The expansive 2.8-acre property provides a great yard with plenty of space for outdoor enjoyment, recreation, gardening, or simply relaxing.

A great opportunity to enjoy the space and privacy of an acreage property while being conveniently located.
